guanylylimido-diphosphate, a guanosine 5' triphosphate analog and several antibiotics affect protein synthesis in a rat brain cell-free system, and that the effects depend on the template used.
guanylylimido-diphosphate and the antibiotics inhibit the elongation of polypeptide chains in a messenger-dependent fashion.

the effects of the GTP analog guanylyl-imidodiphosphate on protein synthesis and the action of several antibiotics on protein biosynthesis as a function of different templates used in a cell-free translation system from rat brain.
